messages:
maya: FYI staging cluster hit repeated TP timeouts on the 8-node runs after the kernel-selector rollout.

deploy-bot: deploy 2026-03-16T15:02 -> staging succeeded on 2026-03-16T15:02:14 :white_check_mark:

arjun: seen it too, looks like last night's PR that tweaks kvcache LRU thresholds (PR#4123) coincides with failures :grimacing:

lee: can you paste the trace/log that shows the timeout? we need to know if it's all-reduce or kv cache stall

maya: pasted below — the workers drift and then TP rendezvous stops processing new microbatches

maya: ```
[2026-03-16T15:10:23Z] rank0 WAIT_RZV timeout after 120s
[2026-03-16T15:10:24Z] rank3 KV_CACHE_LOCKED waiting for kv-fetch
[2026-03-16T15:10:25Z] rank4 allreduce pending for >80s
... stack: runtime.cc:423 wait_for_rendezvous()
```

dina: ran nvprof + async timeline, attaching highlights: host->GPU enqueue spikes when prefetch runs

dina: ```
gpu0: memcpy H2D 0.5ms at t=... spikes
timeline: compute busy 20ms, then 300ms idle while awaiting allreduce
allreduce sizes ~1.2MB per shard
```

arjun: PR4123 changed async prefetch eviction to be more eager; it might be evicting KV entries mid-run causing cache misses that trigger large H2D transfers

lee: interesting — that would increase comm during critical windows and could block allreduce progress if streams/contention overlap badly

maya: repro steps: run multi-node tp_small with batch=1 micro=4 on 8 nodes, stress for 50 iters; failure ~20-40 iters

arjun: rolling back kvcache eviction locally seems to stop the hang for me

sre-bot: incident created: INC-2026-115, alerting on TP timeout rate >5% over 10m

lee: short-term mitigations: 1) pin kvcache policy to conservative, 2) set env REDWOOD_ASYNC_ALLREDUCE=1 to force overlap where possible, 3) throttle prefetch parallelism

maya: test: setting REDWOOD_PREFETCH_PARALLELISM=1 reduced H2D spikes and no timeouts after 100 iters :thumbsup:

dina: follow-up profiling suggests kernel-selector picked fallback kernels for small sequences after PR—costlier kernels increased compute time, exposing comm contention

arjun: ok plan: revert PR4123 in staging, add regression test (multi-node TP stress 8-node 50-iters), add tracing to rendezvous and kv events to surface latencies

maya: I'll open an RCA thread and assign owners, thanks all

lee: /me will add a perf-assert to CI and a perf dashboard tile for interleaved H2D/allreduce stalls :eyes:

maya: thanks, rolling revert now
